decisions.reason: Healthcare and hospitality recruitment sits far from the maritime core and the website shows no reported results, so its option value is doubtful, but keeping a recruitment service that runs on the existing crewing infrastructure costs little, so it stays open one more year.
Superyacht crew recruitment uses the firm's large seafarer pool and crewing centres at low marginal cost, which makes it a cheap option worth holding.
The Smart Academy is quickly building a partner network of six institutions, an early positive signal that justifies further commitment.
FuelEU Maritime monitoring is a regulatory necessity for clients, and the firm submitted all monitoring plans before the deadline, so the value of this service is largely confirmed.
The dashboard is integrated into the PAL software, so it costs little to maintain and supports ongoing FuelEU compliance as the regulation's effects unfold.
The cost simulator is cheap to keep inside PAL, and its value grows as FuelEU penalties and pooling decisions become relevant to clients.
